global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with visible noodles and toppings. Nori, chashu, menma, and naruto are artfully arranged atop, in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle scratches with glossy reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is light golden, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and scattered green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: Dark, crinkled nori seaweed with irregular, frayed edges and a slightly glossy surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, slightly fatty texture with golden-brown sear and visible marbling on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with irregular shapes and visible fibrous texture.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, fluted, circular with pink spiral swirl on top.
